create_model_arguments: create ModelArguments instance to configure a pretrained HuggingFace model for compression
build_model_config: build ModelArguments with custom tokenizer, config_name, and processor paths for model loading
test_model_precision: test ModelArguments with precision set to different values like fp16, bf16, or auto for weight casting
refactor_model_auth: refactor ModelArguments to enable use_auth_token for loading private HuggingFace models
summarize_model_fields: summarize all ModelArguments fields including model, tokenizer, precision, and trust_remote_code options
